analyses.outcome_group: further bleeding after early versus elective colonoscopy
analyses.timepoint_policy: Accept each study's source-reported post-index-examination follow-up window, from in-hospital through 30 days; retain its definition in the evidence record.

rules: Select a candidate when it is a randomized early-versus-elective colonoscopy comparison, has the declared binary outcome and estimand, and its required numeric fields are complete.
Do not use article-specific selection notes, target-review row labels, or target combined effects.

method_selection_policy: After identifying eligible independent evidence, select and justify a synthesis approach from the study data. The participant package does not prescribe a computation method.
